answer_1.quote: TruthfulQA encompasses two tasks: multiple-choice and open-ended generation. In open-ended generation task, LLM directly generates the answer.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to questions directly using greedy decoding.

answer_2.quote: Following the standard procedure on TruthfulQA, we employ two fine-tuned GPT-3 models to judge whether the answer is truthful and informative, denoted as True (%) and Info (%) respectively, while the product True*Info (%) serves as the primary metric.

answer_3.quote: we utilize two fine-tuned GPT-3 models, namely "GPT-judge" and "GPT-info", to assess the truthfulness and informativeness of the responses, i.e., performing binary classification on the truthfulness and informativeness of the response.
